posts.title: Raptor's Rule
posts.description: Find the person in your org who has high impact, and does NOT want the spotlight. Reward that person on their terms. My mother in law likes to decide what you want for Christmas. Don't do that. Ask the kid what he wants for Christmas. Only recognizing the people in your org who are making noise is lazy leadership. posts.title: On Tenure
posts.description: We all know the trope about job hoppers. They're unreliable, lack loyalty, etc. But what about the employee with 10+ years of tenure?
